Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare Apps

AI is considered a crucial asset in healthcare because it analyzes medical images, like ultrasound scans and Pap smears, and its algorithms can detect irregularities and patterns that may state the presence of these cancers. This technology enhances early detection rates, contributing to more effective treatment for women. AI fertility-tracking apps and devices have become invaluable tools for women seeking to conceive. Also, the technologies can determine factors, such as hormonal levels, basal body temperature, and menstrual cycles, to forecast ovulation and detect the optimal time for conception. Furthermore, AI can offer personalized recommendations for lifestyle changes and fertility treatments, maximizing the chances of a successful pregnancy.

Restraint

Lack of knowledge about femtech

Medical reliability on fertility apps provides inaccurate medical information, used or is developed or recommended by reproductive health experts. Most femtech apps offer users generalized predictions based on learning algorithms, which are not comprehensive, transparent, individualized, and explainable analyses of complex medical and psychological aspects of their menstruation and fertility. This is problematic since the often misleading and unreliable information provided by femtech apps can lead to, for example, unwanted pregnancies and cause great health risks for users.

AI usually help women track their menstrual cycles, fertility windows, and potential health issues based on data patterns. This customized approach not only improves the effectiveness of mental health strategies but also helps to decline the stigma surrounding mental health issues and supportive dialogue about women’s mental wellness.

  • By vector, the viral vector segment dominated the market in 2024.

How is AI enhancing the gene therapy industry?

Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing gene therapy by accelerating research, enhancing treatment precision, and streamlining manufacturing processes. AI algorithms determine vast datasets to identify genetic variations associated to diseases, forecast treatment outcomes, and improve gene editing strategies. This contributes to more efficient as well as personalized therapies with fewer side effects. Moreover, it determines genomic data to detect genes and genetic variations associated with diseases, assisting researchers pinpoint potential therapeutic targets and improving the design of delivery vectors (such as viruses) to improve gene delivery efficiency and reduce off-target effects. Meanwhile, AI can determine patient data to detect individuals most likely to respond to a specific gene therapy, enhancing treatment success rates. AI-powered biosensors can tackle manufacturing processes in real-time, guranteeing product quality and consistency.

Market overview

Gene therapy is described as the treatment of an illness by changing, replacing, or supplementing a missing or defective genetic combination that is responsible for the disease. The gene therapy has become one of the most desirable research goals in the fight against degenerative illnesses. The need for gene therapy is being driven by an increase in the number of cases of cancer and other chronic diseases all across the world. The advancements in gene therapies are projected to be approved in the upcoming years, contributing to the gene therapy market’s growth during the forecast period.

The gene therapies are designed to treat diseases by altering genetic information, such as inactivating malfunctioning genes or replacing a disease-causing gene with a healthy copy of the gene. Gene therapy is being utilized to treat a variety of disorders and has been demonstrated to be effective. This form of treatment can cure diseases such as diabetes, cancer, heart disease, and AIDS.

Market Dynamics

Drivers

What is the growing incidence of rare genetic disorders driving the gene therapy market?

The growing incidence and prevalence of rare genetic disorders are indeed a significant driver for the gene therapy market. This is because gene therapy provides a potential curative approach for many of these conditions, which are usually untreatable with traditional therapies. The growing incidence of rare genetic disorders has contributed to a surge in clinical trials for gene therapies. These trials are vital for developing as well as validating new therapies, with many showing promising results.

The US FDA has accepted numerous gene therapies for rare diseases, including Zolgensma for spinal muscular atrophy, and Luxturna for inherited retinal dystrophy, demonstrating the potency of gene therapy to transform treatment for these conditions.

Restraint

What are the ethical concerns restraining the gene therapy market?

Ethical concerns significantly restrain the gene therapy market by producing barriers to research, development, as well as widespread adoption of these treatments. These concerns revolve around problem of informed consent, safety along with efficacy, equitable access, and the potency for social inequalities. The high expenses of gene therapy can create remarkable barriers to access, mainly for peoples from low-income backgrounds or in resource-restricted settings. This can lead to a broadening of health disparities, with gene therapy becoming available only to the wealthy, thus exacerbating existing social inequalities.

Opportunity

How are innovations in viral and non-viral vector platforms an opportunity for the gene therapy market?

Innovations in both viral and non-viral vector platforms are driving significant opportunities in the gene therapy market by enhancing efficacy, safety, and even scalability of gene delivery. Researchers are developing engineered viral capsids (the protein shell of a virus) to improve targeting of specific cell types along with decrease immune responses. Emerging viral vectors, like those based on adeno-associated viruses (AAV) and even lentiviruses, are being explored for their potency in treating a broader array of diseases. Strategies such as co-administration of immunosuppressive agents and also plasmapheresis are being developed to overcome immune barriers and enhance gene delivery.

Type Insights

The gene silencing segment dominated the gene therapy market with the largest share in 2024 owing to its high accuracy. The gene silencing mechanism enables precise targeting of specific genes that are responsible for diseases. This targeted approach reduces the expression of harmful genes, making it ideal for treating various diseases, such as cancers, genetic disorders, and viral infections. Furthermore, gene silencing is increasingly being used to produce therapeutics for cancer and other diseases.

The gene augmentation segment is the fastest growing in the gene therapy market during the forecast period. Gene augmentation is mainly well-suited for treating diseases caused by a single gene defect, like hemophilia, cystic fibrosis, and spinal muscular atrophy. Successful clinical trials as well as regulatory approvals of gene augmentation therapies are driving investor confidence and boosting thus investment in this area.

Vector Insights

The viral vector segment held around 85% share of the market in 2024 due to its capability to target specific cells with precision. Viral vectors have high transduction rates, making them suitable for transferring genes into targeted cells. The increase in demand for targeted delivery systems further bolstered the segment. In addition, they are effective at delivering genetic materials into host cells, making them suitable for gene therapy.

The non-viral vector segment is expected to be the most opportunistic segment during the forecast period. This is due to the widespread availability of non-viral vector gene treatments. In gene therapy, non-viral vectors are highly preferred over viral vectors due to their ease of production and better safety profile. Moreover, they reduce the risk of insertional mutagenesis, making them a safer option for patients.

Therapeutic Area Insights

The oncology segment dominated the global gene therapy market in 2024. This is mainly due to the rise in the prevalence of cancer across the globe. Gene therapies have gained immense traction to treat cancer due to their ability to target specific cancer cells. Moreover, gene therapies have fewer side effects than chemotherapy, making them a preferable choice. The rise in approval of gene therapies for cancer and incidence of hematologic tumors further bolstered the segment.

The neurology segment is expected to grow rapidly during the forecast period. This is mainly due to the increasing occurrence of neurological diseases, such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. According to the Alzheimer’s Association,Alzheimer's disease was the fifth-leading cause of death in 2021. About 7 million people in the U.S. are living with Alzheimer's, and this number is projected to reach nearly 13 million by 2050. Targeted gene therapy has advanced significantly, allowing for the treatment of neurological illnesses using various techniques, ranging from exogenous gene expression to endogenous gene suppression.

Delivery Method Insights

The in vivo segment registered its dominance in the gene therapy market in 2024. The segment growth is attributed to the fact that the in vivo method delivers genes directly into the patient’s body, enhancing the effectiveness of the treatment. This method is less invasive and eliminates the need for complex procedures, including ex vivo. With the increased demand for targeted therapies, in vivo gene therapy gained immense popularity, propelling the segment.

The in vivo segment dominating and fastest growing in the gene therapy market in 2024. In vivo gene therapy delivers therapeutic genes directly into the patient's body, usual via viral vectors or lipid nanoparticles. This avoids the complexities of cell manipulation along with re-introduction needed in ex vivo methods. Further, they are mainly effective for treating diseases where the affected cells are not easily accessible, like liver diseases, neurological disorders, and some genetic disorders.

Route of Administration Insights

The intravenous segment led the market in 2024. This is mainly due to the ability of intravenous (IV) administration to deliver treatments directly into the bloodstream of the patient. This method is used to treat various conditions due to its ability to deliver gene therapy to multiple targeted organs simultaneously. Moreover, the faster delivery to targeted tissues and high effectiveness bolstered the segment. Advancements in vector design and delivery mechanisms led to the development of minimally invasive IV therapy, contributing to segmental growth.

The other routes of administration segment is the fastest growing in the gene therapy market during the forecast period. The intramuscular route is a key area of expansion, mainly for localized treatments where direct delivery to affected tissues is vital. The intramuscular route is favored for conditions such as muscular dystrophies as well as certain vaccine-related gene therapies, providing targeted delivery with good safety.
